title: A Finger-Sized Shrimp Makes One of the Loudest Sounds in the Sea
subject: pistol shrimp

scenes.text: This finger-sized shrimp makes one of the loudest sounds in the ocean.
Its oversized claw snaps shut so fast it shoots a jet of water at about sixty miles an hour.
The jet makes a bubble. It's the bubble, not the claw, that makes the noise.
When the bubble collapses, the pop can reach 218 decibels.
For a split second, the inside passes four thousand degrees Fahrenheit, about as hot as the surface of the Sun.
A flash of light, a blast of heat and a bang, from a shrimp's snap.

description:

What tiny animal would you give a superpower?
